plugins.name: kickoff
plugins.description: Start any project in one command: brief interview, per-project plugin set, folders, status, decisions, gitignore, health check, resume and wrap-up. Profiles for Unity, Go, NetSuite, mobile, utilities, trading research or your own.

plugins.name: unity-game-kit
plugins.description: Set up any Unity game project for Claude Code: Android build pipeline, Editor checks, local ComfyUI art with model comparison, and a doctor that says what is missing.

plugins.name: guidebook
plugins.description: Reads any project and writes plain-language HTML guides in several versions (layman, client, teammate, maintainer, quick-start), and keeps them current as the project changes.

plugins.name: idea2spec
plugins.description: Interviews you about a rough idea, researches the nearest alternatives, scores it with a go / clarify / kill gate, and writes a spec only if the idea is worth testing.

plugins.name: cachepulse
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter and miss explanations for Claude Code: read share, TTL with source label, per-request timeline.
